Congratulations to the Brownell Talbot robotics team! These Nebraskans went undefeated to secure the title as world champions.
omaha.com/news/local/article…

Glad to see an extension for the Rural Community Hospital Demonstration (RCHD) pass the Senate. I cosponsored this effort because it is critical for healthcare access and sustainability  in our rural communities. This is how you keep rural communities thriving.


Nic Pottebaum (@NicDP)

Nebraska Hospital Assoc: “…That is why the Nebraska Hospital Association is grateful to the Senate for supporting the Rural Community Hospital Demonstration (RCHD) program.”



— https://nitter.net/NicDP/status/2

Last week I was in Singapore for the 2026 Shangri-La Dialogue.

Attending this conference is important to our national security and trade relations.

The U.S. must continue to demonstrate our commitment to deterring Chinese aggression. This ensures peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific. We should also work to expand our market access in this region for American farmers and ranchers.

A fun way to bring neighbors together. Nebraska is what America is supposed to be.
journalstar.com/news/local/a…

Kawasaki has been in Lincoln for 50 years. They’re a fantastic example of manufacturing success in America.

3,000 Nebraskans earn their living here. The Working Families Tax Cuts will better support them and their families.

Video

Nebraska streets are safer thanks to U.S. Attorney Lesley Woods.

We will not tolerate these despicable crimes in our state.

I continue to fight for enforcing our nation’s laws and removing criminal illegal aliens, responsible for terrors like this.


U.S. Attorney Nebraska (@USAO_NE)

🚨US Attorney Lesley A. Woods: Illegal alien from India sentenced to 10 years for sex trafficking minors in Omaha. HSTF rescued two child victims.



— https://nitter.net/USAO_NE/status/2060081149628530705#m

Starting July 4, Nebraska families will have a simple and secure way to access a major new savings and investment program for their kids.  It’s called the Trump Account.

The Trump Account App launched by the Treasury Department will help onboard Americans into this new program. Every eligible child will receive a $1,000 federal contribution starting July 4.

This account will help families save thousands of dollars for their children.  This will give those young people a leg up on paying for ed

A truly remarkable season. Nebraska is proud of you @HuskerSoftball! 

GBR.

There are multiple ways to celebrate 250 years of American freedom this year.

The Legacy of the Plains Museum in Gering is commemorating this historic milestone with a special exhibit, “Our American Stories: Celebrating 250 Years!” I encourage all Nebraskans to pay a visit.

To be part of celebrations across our state, visit: america250.org/calendar/?vie…

May is Mental Health Awareness Month. Earlier this year, I introduced a resolution to designate an annual “National Day of Play.”

There’s nothing better than a day well spent with family and friends. Play builds social connection, sharpens the mind, and keeps us young at heart.

We must combat the loneliness epidemic. National Day of Play encourages Nebraskans to join together across our churches, schools, and communities to enjoy our neighbors and remember to have fun.

This Memorial Day, two patriotic Nebraskans went the extra mile to honor those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedom. They organized a tribute with 350 American flags to line Military Avenue in downtown Fremont. Nebraska is truly what America is supposed to be!
3newsnow.com/northeast-nebra…

Congratulations to the Nebraska Public Power District!  They were awarded $27.8 million to support work that keeps Nebraska an energy powerhouse.

Small Modular Reactors can meet rapidly increasing energy demand, and I’m proud to support their deployment in Nebraska.

When it comes to unleashing American energy dominance, @NPPDNews and Nebraska lead the way!
energy.gov/articles/energy-d…

May is Mental Health Awareness Month. 

As Governor, we worked to improve mental healthcare for all Nebraskans.  That’s why I introduced the Improving Measurements for Loneliness and Isolation Act in the Senate.  This bill works to improve care nation wide.

This month and every month, check in with friends, family and neighbors and let them know you care.

Beautiful morning at Forest Lawn Cemetery honoring and remembering those who paid the ultimate price for our great nation.

Thank you to American Legion Post 1 for hosting this event.🇺🇸

For the last 250 years, Americans have answered the call to serve and defend our great nation.

Today, we remember and honor all the brave women and men who lost their lives in service to our country.

America is the home of the free because of the brave.

GBR!


Nebraska Softball (@HuskerSoftball)
